龙虎山，天师殿外。

云雾散尽，天光通透，秋日暖阳洒落山间，照亮苍翠松柏。殿外青石平台之上，立着一道纤细挺拔的白色身影。

林佳身着749局制式白色工装，长发束起，眉眼清冷干练，褪去了往日的温柔婉转，多了几分公职人员的沉稳锐利。她孤身一人站在殿前，身后没有随行队员，手中捧着一份黑色加密文件袋，袋身印着鲜红的绝密标识。

她一路千里奔波，从江南总部奔赴赣地龙虎山，衣衫沾染风尘，眼底带着疲惫红血丝，却依旧身姿笔直，脊背挺拔。

桃源古镇一战落幕已有十日，夏未来伏法，邪教血咒破灭，失踪异能者尽数解救，南方异常事件彻底平定。可谁也未曾料到，南方尘埃落定之时，北方已然暗流汹涌。

长白山龙脉异常、关外村镇人口离奇失踪、深夜山林邪影横行、普通人莫名染煞患病。749局监测的数据一路飙升，邪术波动频率远超往年任何时期。

经过高层反复核查、情报比对，最终确认，是境外东瀛三派势力潜入东北，暗中布局。

阴阳师、九菊一派、甲贺忍。

三大邪派暗中结盟，盘踞长白山脉，盗取龙脉地气，布设邪煞阵法，图谋不明。

749局北方分局人手匮乏，本土修士战力不足，数次探查皆伤亡惨重，根本无法抗衡训练有素、手段阴狠的东瀛邪修。危急关头，总局将目光投向了华夏各大正统修行宗门。

而龙虎山，便是首要求助对象。

更是因为，龙虎山之内，藏着一位最合适的人选。

胡九郎。

此人精通符箓阵法、阴阳卜算，体术强悍，心性坚韧，更是极少数能够硬抗邪术、破除咒杀的顶尖修士。桃源古镇一战，他以凡人之躯催动禁咒，战力强悍，早已被总局高层记入重点征召名单。

林佳缓步踏入天师殿，目光扫过殿内古朴陈设，最终落在端坐蒲团的白发天师身上。她微微躬身行礼，姿态恭敬，恪守礼数。

“林佳，见过天师。”

白发天师睁开眼眸，浑浊目光落在她身上，语气平淡无波：“749局千里迢迢上山，所求何事？”

林佳没有多余寒暄，当即拆开手中加密文件袋，将一叠厚厚的情报资料平铺在案几之上。纸张之上，印满长白山地形图、邪术波动监测数据、东瀛三派势力解析资料，字迹密密麻麻，标注着各类危险预警。

“天师，东北告急。”林佳语气凝重，开门见山，“近一个月，长白山龙脉持续紊乱，地气外泄，煞气逆流。我方探查人员确认，东瀛三大邪派盘踞关外，暗中布设献祭大阵，疑似想要唤醒地底上古妖物，盗取华夏龙脉本源。”

Longhu Mountain, outside Tianshi Hall.

The clouds and mists have cleared, the sky is clear, and the warm autumn sun shines down on the mountains, illuminating the green pines and cypresses.On the bluestone platform outside the hall, a slender and tall white figure stood.

Lin Jia is wearing the 749 Bureau's standard white work clothes, with long hair tied up, and her eyebrows are cold and capable. She has lost the gentleness and gentleness of the past, and has a bit more calmness and sharpness of a public official.She stood alone in front of the hall, with no accompanying members behind her, holding a black encrypted document bag with a bright red top secret logo printed on the bag.

She traveled thousands of miles from the Jiangnan headquarters to Longhu Mountain in Ganland. Her clothes were stained by wind and dust, and her eyes were red and bloodshot from exhaustion, but her posture was still straight and her back was straight.

It has been ten days since the battle in Taoyuan Ancient Town ended. Xia Lai has committed suicide, the blood curse of the cult has been broken, all the missing people with supernatural powers have been rescued, and the abnormal incidents in the south have been completely put down.But no one expected that when the dust settled in the south, there was already an undercurrent in the north.

The dragon veins in Changbai Mountain are abnormal, people in villages and towns outside the pass are mysteriously missing, evil shadows are rampant in the mountains and forests late at night, and ordinary people are inexplicably infected with evil spirits and illnesses.The data monitored by Bureau 749 has been soaring, and the frequency of magic fluctuations is far higher than at any time in previous years.

After repeated high-level verification and intelligence comparison, it was finally confirmed that three overseas Japanese factions had sneaked into the Northeast and made secret arrangements.

Onmyoji, Kuju Ichipa, Koga Ninja.

The three evil sects formed a secret alliance and occupied the Changbai Mountains, stealing the dragon's veins and earth energy, and setting up evil formations with unknown intentions.

The Northern Branch of Bureau 749 is short of manpower and the local monks have insufficient combat power. They have suffered heavy casualties in several explorations. They are unable to compete with the well-trained and ruthless Japanese evil cultivators.At this critical juncture, the General Administration turned its attention to the major orthodox cultivation sects in China.

And Longhu Mountain is the primary target for help.

It's because there is a most suitable candidate hidden in Longhu Mountain.

Hu Jiulang.

This person is proficient in talisman formations, yin and yang divination, has strong physical skills, and a tough mind. He is one of the few top monks who can resist evil spells and break curses.During the battle in Taoyuan Ancient Town, he used his mortal body to activate the forbidden curse. His combat power was so strong that he had already been included in the key recruitment list by the senior management of the General Administration.

Lin Jia walked slowly into the Celestial Master's Hall, her eyes swept across the simple furnishings in the hall, and finally landed on the white-haired Celestial Master sitting on the futon.She bowed slightly to salute, her posture was respectful, and she adhered to the etiquette.

"Lin Jia, I have met the Celestial Master."

The white-haired Heavenly Master opened his eyes, his turbid gaze fell on her, and his tone was calm: "In the 749th round, you went all the way up the mountain, what do you want?"

Lin Jia didn't have any extra words to say. She immediately opened the encrypted document bag in her hand and laid out a thick stack of intelligence materials on the desk.The paper is printed with topographic maps of Changbai Mountain, monitoring data on magic fluctuations, and information on analysis of the three Japanese sects. The handwriting is densely packed with various danger warnings.

"Tianshi, there is an emergency in the Northeast." Lin Jia spoke solemnly and got straight to the point. "In the past month, the dragon veins of Changbai Mountain have continued to be chaotic, the earth's energy leaked out, and the evil energy flowed backwards. Our investigators confirmed that the three evil sects of Japan are entrenched outside the pass and secretly set up sacrifice arrays. They are suspected of wanting to awaken the ancient monsters underground and steal the origin of the Chinese dragon veins."
